excerpt_i18n.en: This is a long-awaited moment in embodied intelligence: artificial intelligence is transitioning from eloquent speech on screens to the unity of knowledge and action in the physical world. On December 12, 2025, in Shanghai, China, the GDPS 2025 Global Developer Pioneer Conference and International Embodied Intelligence Skills Competition will officially commence. We are about to witness an industry realization spanning all four seasons. If the February Global Developer Pioneer Conference showcased a "blooming of a hundred flowers" in software algorithms, this year-end GDPS event is dedicated to delivering the "abundant fruits" of hardware implementation. Promises about intelligence are made in spring, and answers about the body are harvested by year's end. It follows not the calendar seasons but the cycle of innovation—spring blossoms yield autumn fruits, and implementation reigns supreme. As the world's first top-tier competition in embodied intelligence fully benchmarked against the "WorldSkills" standards, this is not just a contest of technology but the ultimate test to verify whether silicon-based life can truly integrate into human production and daily life.
